findings.title: Diff reverts the exact fix for Jinja2 autoescape not applying
findings.problem: Global CLAUDE.md Security section (absolute): 'in Jinja2, never apply | safe to user content or disable autoescaping.' This diff deletes the explicit jinja2.Environment(..., autoescape=True) + Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env) construction and replaces it with Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True), the pattern commit e11187e replaced because Starlette removed the **env_options passthrough. uv.lock pins starlette==0.52.1.
findings.fix_hint: Restore the pattern from commit e11187e: build jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) and pass it via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env), re-adding the import jinja2 line.
findings.why_it_matters: If autoescape=True is dropped by Starlette's directory= constructor, every template render stops HTML-escaping output, opening an XSS path across the whole web UI.

members.title: Diff reverts the supported Jinja2Templates env= API back to a kwarg the locked Starlette no longer accepts
members.problem: This hunk exactly reverses HEAD commit e11187e. uv.lock pins starlette 0.52.1, whose Jinja2Templates.__init__ takes only directory, context_processors and env, with no **kwargs. So Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) raises TypeError when the module is imported. routes.py is imported by triggarr/__main__.py, triggarr/search/scheduler.py, tests/test_web.py and tests/test_middleware.py, so the daemon will not start and those test modules will not import.

members.title: Jinja2Templates called with unsupported `autoescape` kwarg, crashes app at import
members.problem: fastapi.templating.Jinja2Templates is a direct re-export of starlette.templating.Jinja2Templates (installed starlette 0.52.1, pinned by uv.lock). Its __init__ only accepts directory, context_processors, and env. Calling Jinja2Templates(directory=str(TEMPLATES_DIR), autoescape=True) raises TypeError at module import time. triggarr/__main__.py imports routes at startup, so the whole app fails to boot.

members.why_it_matters: Total-outage bug: the process will not start. It also silently reverts the explicit-autoescape safeguard the preceding commit introduced.
members.fix_hint: Revert to the previous pattern (explicit jinja2.Environment with autoescape=True passed via env=), or drop the autoescape kwarg entirely since directory-based construction already sets autoescape=jinja2.select_autoescape().

members.title: Jinja2Templates(autoescape=True) raises TypeError on the installed Starlette, so the app fails at import
members.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e. That commit's message says Starlette dropped the **env_options passthrough in Jinja2Templates, so `autoescape=True` no longer works and a preconfigured jinja2.Environment is the supported API. The installed Starlette in .venv is 1.3.1, and its Jinja2Templates.__init__ only accepts `directory`, `context_processors` and `env`. It has no **kwargs. The new line passes `autoescape=True`, which raises TypeError while triggarr/web/routes.py is being imported, so the web app cannot start. pyproject.toml lists `fastapi` with no version pin. uv.lock pins starlette 0.52.1, where env_options is only deprecated, so the result depends on which Starlette version gets resolved.

members.problem: The installed Starlette is 0.52.1 (uv.lock). Its Jinja2Templates.__init__ accepts only directory, context_processors and env. Passing autoescape=True raises TypeError when triggarr.web.routes is imported at module level. That module is imported by triggarr/__main__.py:17 (the app entrypoint), triggarr/search/scheduler.py:204, tests/test_web.py:22 and tests/test_middleware.py. The daemon fails to boot and those test modules fail at collection. This diff reverts commit e11187e.

members.title: Diff reverts the prior autoescape fix, crashing the app and dropping the forced-autoescape guarantee
members.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e. The installed, lockfile-pinned starlette 0.52.1 Jinja2Templates.__init__(self, directory=None, *, context_processors=None, env=None) has no **kwargs/env_options passthrough. Calling Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) raises TypeError at module import time, crashing the whole application. Even setting the crash aside, this reverts a security-hardening commit: the prior code forced autoescaping unconditionally; dropping the kwarg would fall back to Starlette's extension-dependent select_autoescape().

members.why_it_matters: The app fails to start as soon as routes.py is imported. If the crash is papered over by removing the kwarg, the explicit unconditional autoescape hardening is replaced by extension-based autoescaping.
members.fix_hint: Restore the pre-diff code: build jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) and pass it via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env).

Although uv.lock records an older Starlette, Dockerfile installs via pip install . and pyproject.toml leaves FastAPI unconstrained.
